rule: lineage-stratified hold-out drawn only from train_head lines, mirroring scripts/freeze_tx1_phase_a.py's stratified_holdout/_allocate_test_counts: per-lineage allocation proportional to the train_head pool size (floor of lineage_count * validation_count / pool_size), remainder slots assigned one at a time to the lineage with the largest fractional shortfall (ties broken by lineage pool size, then lineage name), never leaving a lineage with zero train_head lines remaining; then numpy.random.default_rng(seed).choice per allocated lineage (visited in sorted alphabetical order) without replacement from that lineage's own sorted model_id list
